artifact_role: secondary preregistration for episode-concentration robustness only
episode_definition: maximal contiguous run of one executed one-bar-lagged V6.6 regime; screening contribution uses exactly the dates assigned to that regime episode, including its entry rebalance date and excluding the next episode's entry rebalance date
segment_rule: for pre-2020 and post-2019 screening, only whole episodes whose start and end both lie inside the segment are eligible
screening_metric: sum(log1p(policy net return) - log1p(realized-exposure-matched static-control net return)) across episode dates
leaveout_selection: largest positive active-log episode within each segment
leaveout_replacement: replace the selected episode's preregistered regime target with the corresponding original segment exposure-matched static target; rerun the full portfolio path with monthly plus target-change rebalancing
leaveout_control: solve a fresh monthly-rebalanced realized-exposure-matched static control against the leaveout path on the evaluation segment
interpretation_boundary: post-hoc robustness attribution only; may diagnose concentration but may not alter or tune the primary policy matrix
